purpose: Extend the existing Settings & Location surface with the accepted two-provider selection and secret model while retaining W9 location/catalog behavior and keeping provider transport in Weather Context.
success_outcome: A clean build and deterministic redacted evidence prove that Open-Meteo is the no-key default, OpenWeather is selected explicitly with an owner-local key, provider/key failures preserve the last valid state without fallback claims, and Open-Meteo plus GeoNames attribution appears in the accepted Settings order.
anti_goals: Do not implement provider HTTP transport, response mapping, Weather Context dispatch, cache/history identity or forecast completeness; those are downstream FT-002/FT-003/FT-004 tasks.
Do not reimplement or replace the accepted W9 offline GeoNames catalog, aliases, default/selected location or location persistence.
Do not add a third provider, automatic fallback, shared/embedded key, backend/proxy, cloud/account service, Google Services, plugin framework, registry, DI framework or event bus.
Do not place real or synthetic key values in durable source, resources, logs, screenshots, fixtures or evidence.

forbidden_scope: weather adapter implementations, outbound provider requests and normalized weather/cache/history state
hourly and long-term forecast completeness or presentation
new location source, extra Settings controls or FT-009 personalization behavior
backend/cloud/accounts, Google Services, event/message infrastructure, plugin/DI registry and new dependencies
live credentials or secret-bearing durable artifacts
stop_conditions: Stop and ask the operator before changing the accepted two-provider set, default selection, local-secret posture, attribution requirement or product behavior.
Stop and route to /spec-design if implementation needs a new module, graph edge, public boundary, storage owner or composition-root business owner.
Stop and route to /feature-to-tasks FT-008 if task identity, tier, dependency, AC ownership or material scope must change.
Stop and defer transport/dispatch/cache behavior to TASK-020-T3-FT-002-W17 rather than widening this Settings task.

constraints: Settings & Location is the sole mutable owner of provider selection, selected location and the OpenWeather owner key; valid changes auto-save and invalid changes preserve the last valid value.
The provider set is exactly Open-Meteo and OpenWeather. Open-Meteo is the default and has no key path; OpenWeather is activated only by explicit owner selection with its local key.
Settings may request the accepted refresh command after a valid selection/location change but does not call adapters, normalize weather, own cache/history or decide fallback.
Open-Meteo and GeoNames attributions precede the final back action. Existing W9 catalog/location and FT-009 personalization behavior remain intact.
No hard write_boundary is declared; advisory files plus forbidden scope and stop conditions define the deliberate task boundary.
